label: Igneous rocks
text: EA.O.A1.2 Igneous rocks. Formed from melt. Texture records cooling rate. Bowen's reaction series is the idealised crystallisation order of a basaltic melt cooling slowly with equilibrium reaction. Few magmas complete it. Classification follows IUGS (W12).

warrant.standard: Analytical identification (XRD, microprobe) with stated precision
